dedupe_keys.name: travia traffic trajectory visualization and annotation

description: TraViA is a Python tool for viewing and annotating recorded vehicle trajectories. Its README describes adapters for NGSIM, pNEUMA, HighD and ExiD, letting a researcher inspect traffic movements from different data providers in one environment. It supports manual annotations and includes examples for detecting situations, drawing heat-map overlays and plotting vehicle signals. The time span and geographic coverage come from the files a user opens; TraViA does not publish or bundle those full traffic datasets. The source and setup guidance are public under GPL-3.0, with documented testing on Windows and Ubuntu using Python 3.12. Annotated trajectories may help choose car-following scenarios, examine conflicts, or prepare calibration data for road-traffic simulation. Dataset access terms and any data cleaning remain the user’s responsibility. Visual annotation is also subject to reviewer judgement, and the tool does not itself establish that a simulated traffic model is valid. Catalogue records data-ngsim-vehicle-trajectories and data-highd-drone-vehicle-trajectories describe two distinct input datasets. This review inspected metadata and documentation only; it did not obtain trajectory files or run the interface.
